title: Talan
dek: A divine figure whose confrontation with Aria and attributed place in Voraketh’s history carry lasting consequences.
body:
Talan is a god of Justice and Order in Fenumion’s public record. Aria’s history remembers him through childhood fear, the destruction of his temple and the later confrontation in which he kills her. Her experience of him shapes how she speaks about safety and power.

Consequences that remain

The recorded confrontation on 6 November 2025 ends Aria’s life but does not erase the people, institutions and harm she leaves behind. Talan’s role in that ending connects him to Zarathis’s subsequent memory and political history.

An attributed place in Voraketh

The public Voraketh account attributes the island’s Chains and guardians to Talan through Nuru’s testimony to Anky. This remains an attributed account, not a complete reconstruction of their creation or proof of Talan’s home island.
